thread:
sara-support: FYI — escalated ticket from ACME. Streaming API keeps dropping mid-response when they go through their ALB -> envoy sidecar. Customer sees a partial SSE payload then client reconnect loop. Repro steps + logs below.

andrew-customer: adding details from their end — they hit our hosted endpoint via ALB, route goes to our Envoy fronting the runtime. They said it usually fails around 25–40s into a long stream. Sometimes last chunk missing, sometimes client reconnects and we get duplicate partial outputs.

mike-oncall: thanks. can you paste the raw curl you used to repro? any ALB idle timeout configured?

andrew-customer: repro curl:```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" --no-buffer "https://api.example.com/v1/stream?model=redwood-large"```
ALB idle timeout is 30s on their stack. they said they saw the connection close immediately after 30s for one stream, other times earlier (26s).

sara-support: customer provided snippets from the client: `data: {"id":"msg-123","text":"...the text cuts off here"}\n` followed by `ERR_CONNECTION_RESET` in their browser console. ALB access log shows `target: 502, status: 200` in a few events (weird), Envoy admin logs show `upstream reset` and `downstream connection closed`.

tina-eng-runtime: likely interplay between ALB TCP idle timeout and Envoy HTTP stream idle handling. two quick hypotheses: 1) ALB closes the TCP connection at its idle timeout which causes a FIN mid-stream so the client sees a truncated response, 2) Envoy route/connection-level timeouts can also `reset` upstream when it thinks the stream is idle. We need a repro that isolates ALB from Envoy.

rick-support: quick mitigation for customers: a) bump ALB idle timeout to >= stream max duration (eg 120s) or b) send SSE heartbeats from server every ~15s (`: keepalive\n\n`) so ALB sees activity and won't hit idle. c) ensure `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and no `Content-Length`.

andrew-customer: we tried heartbeats and it definitely reduced hits but didn't completely stop them — still saw 1/20 failures. they also have Cloudflare in front for some routes, not for all. could CF be buffering?

tina-eng-runtime: yes Cloudflare will buffer some responses unless configured to stream (and some plans/proxies will buffer and close). Add `Cache-Control: no-transform` and ensure `Content-Type: text/event-stream`. For ALB specifically, confirm it's an HTTP(S) ALB (L7) — ALB can terminate and re-initiate HTTP semantics which can interact poorly with some sidecars. If they use NLB (L4) the behavior is different.

mike-oncall: can we get Envoy config snippet for route timeouts? to suggest a safe default to disable early route idle close for streaming routes?

steph-obs: example route config we use internally (route-level idle handling):
```yaml
route_config:
  virtual_hosts:
  - name: api
    routes:
    - match: { prefix: "/v1/stream" }
      route:
        cluster: runtime
        idle_timeout: 0s   # disable route idle timeout for SSE endpoints
```
This is what folks have set when they run long streams. (Note: our internal field names vary by Envoy version but the idea is to avoid route-level idle cutoff.)

tina-eng-runtime: additional things to check in Envoy: `stream_idle_timeout`, `per_try_idle_timeout`, and `max_connection_duration`. if any of those are shorter than ALB idle, you get surprises. For a quick workaround: 1) set route idle_timeout to 0s (disable), 2) ensure server emits SSE heartbeat comments every 10–15s, 3) if using ALB, set its idle timeout > client expected longest stream (or use NLB to avoid L7 rewrapping).

andrew-customer: they also reported occasional `401` during reconnects — looks like their client refresh logic sometimes races with reconnect. so when reconnect happens we sometimes reject because token refresh wasn't finished.

rick-support: good to call out — reconnect loop + auth refresh races will compound visible errors. ask customer to switch to short-lived tokens + refresh preemptively or return `401` with `WWW-Authenticate` hints so client can trigger refresh and retry once.

sara-support: proposed next steps for ACME: 1) set ALB idle timeout to 120s and test; 2) enable SSE heartbeat in their app (we can provide a short snippet); 3) if still failing, re-run repro with direct NLB -> envoy (bypassing ALB) so we can tell if ALB is culprit; 4) collect Envoy `admin` / `upstream` logs around the failure.

andrew-customer: ack — they will try the ALB change and heartbeat.

mike-oncall: assigning to tina to open an internal incident and track: we should add a KB article for "streaming truncation when behind ALB/Cloudflare/Envoy" with recommended config (ALB idle, Envoy route idle, SSE heartbeat, cache-control no-transform) and a reproducible `curl` test.

tina-eng-runtime: I'll open RWI-1234 and draft the KB. also adding a tiny server-side SSE heartbeat snippet they can copy:```js
// node express example
res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream');
res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-transform');
res.write(': heartbeat\n\n');
setInterval(() => res.write(': heartbeat\n\n'), 15000);
```

sara-support: thanks everyone. assigning follow-ups: tina (internal ticket + KB), rick (work with customer on ALB change), mike (monitor for regression). deploy-bot: could you add a note to the incident channel with the ticket link when created?

deploy-bot: Incident RWI-1234 created by tina-eng-runtime — KB draft in progress.

sara-support: closing loop here — will follow up once ACME confirms ALB change result. :thumbsup:
